title: Bind a diagram element to product intent
statement: As an architect, I can bind a specific diagram element to the story or criterion it explains and inspect that intent separately from its code evidence so reviewers do not mistake a whole slide for implementation proof.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Creating a visual explains or addresses relation from a deck or slide is rejected without writing a relation, while the same relation from a slide Item is accepted.
When an Item has both a story link and code evidence, the reviewer exposes separate Story and Code controls, and each opens only its corresponding drawer content.
The Item Story drawer shows the linked story, criterion when targeted, rationale, and current, stale, or invalid currency.
The slide story summary counts each story once from active exact-Item links; legacy slide or deck links are excluded from the count and shown as needing element assignment.
Hovering or focusing the slide story summary highlights only Items with exact story links, and removing hover or focus clears the preview.
